sample_mapping_evidence: GEO overall design identifies two new-onset SLE patients and one healthy volunteer, with one PBMC specimen per GSM; sample titles SLE-1/SLE-2/C-1 are study-scoped donor identifiers.

title: SLE-1
characteristics_ch1: subject status: systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) patient
extract_protocol_ch1: 1. After collection of cells, centrifuge at a speed not exceeding 400rcf (adjust the speed and centrifugation time according to the cell types). Carefully discard the supernatant and retain the cell precipitation.  2. The  cell  pellet  was  resuspended  by  1mL 1X  PBS  containing  0.04%  BSA and the washing procedure was repeated twice. After washing, appropriate volume PBS was added to the cell precipitation to obtain single-cell dispersion suspension with a concentration close to the goal number. A type of wide-bore pipette tip was used in cell resuspension for a lower cell damage. If necessary, cell filter should be applied to remove cell debris and clusters (eg. 30µm MACS SmartStrainers and 40µm FlowmiTM Cell Strainer). 3.Automatic cytometry was used to determine the cell concentration. And the sample volume was calculated based on the optimal cell sampling concentration supplied by 10X official website and the target capture number. If the calculated concentration is too high, adjust the liquid volume to the appropriate concentration and repeat counting once more. Once the desired cell suspension was obtained, immediately place the samples on ice for subsequent GEMs preparation and reverse transcription.

1. Interrupt, end repair and add A base. Finally the SPRIselect beads was used to purify the product.  2. Adaptor ligation and SPRIselect purification.  3. Index PCR and SPRIselect purification.  4. Qubit® 3.0 Flurometer (Life Technologies, CA, USA) was used to determine the library concentration.  5. Agilent 2100 High Sensitivity DNA Assay Kit (Agilent Technologies, CA, USA)    was used to determine the distribution of library product fragments.
data_processing: The Cell Ranger software pipeline (version 3.1.0) were used for genome alignment, calling Cell Barcodes and estimating multiplet rates .
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Matrix table with raw gene counts for every gene and every cell
